stem_en: Given below are two statements In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below

statements.label: I
statements.text: In the coagulation of a negative sol, the flocculating power of the three given ions is in the order $\mathrm{Al3+} > \mathrm{Ba2+} > \mathrm{Na+}$

statements.label: II
statements.text: In the coagulation of a positive sol, the flocculating power of the three given salts is in the order $\mathrm{NaCl} > \mathrm{Na2SO4} > \mathrm{Na3PO4}$

options_en.1: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
options_en.2: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
options_en.3: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
options_en.4: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

b6_reason: Hardy-Schulze rule: coagulating power rises with ion charge, so Al3+ > Ba2+ > Na+ is right, but for a positive sol the anion order must be Na3PO4 > Na2SO4 > NaCl, the reverse of what Statement II says.
